scripts.process-qc: npm run run && node dist/scripts/processQc.js && npm run start
scripts.process-crosscheck: npm run run && node dist/scripts/processCrosschecks.js && npm run start
scripts.process-qc2:json: npm run run && node dist/scripts/new/processQc2.js --type json
scripts.process-qc2:csv: npm run run && node dist/scripts/new/processQc2.js --type csv
scripts.start:platform:json: npm run getPlatformData && npm run process-qc2:json && npm run start
scripts.start:sheet:csv: npm run getPlatformData && npm run process-qc2:csv && npm run start
